verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing says you can apply online in 10 minutes (mercury-docs-26) and get business credit cards as soon as day one (mercury-docs-27). That points to a fast onboarding flow, but nothing documents how long account approval and full setup take end to end. missing for 10: documented approval/verification timelines, evidence of full onboarding (KYC, account opening, team and integration setup) completing within about a week, independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
